title: The laundromat, closed
logline: The laundromat's window in April, CLOSED card, the machines inside under sheets, the place on the wall where the rack was. No figure. Absent.

panels.composition: A laundromat's front window with a closed card, washing machines inside under sheets, a pale rectangle on the wall where a rack hung, nobody.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a laundromat's front window with a closed card and washing machines inside under sheets, a pale rectangle on the wall where something hung, no people, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
